name: aindrive-mobile
description: aindrive mobile — installable Android/iOS app that runs the aindrive agent on the phone and serves a real device folder as a drive.

scripts.android: npm run sync && cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run sync && cap open ios
scripts.apk:debug: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
